description: This file defines the TlsConnectionFeature class implementing TLS-related security features, including certificates, protocols, and cryptographic algorithms, within the Orleans.Connections.Security namespace.

classes.name: TlsConnectionFeature
classes.description: Implements TLS connection features such as certificates, protocols, and cryptographic algorithms, conforming to ITlsConnectionFeature, ITlsApplicationProtocolFeature, and ITlsHandshakeFeature interfaces.

methods.name: GetRemoteCertificateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the remote certificate associated with the TLS connection.
